title: 4.2万粉丝，却依然在找产品市场契合度：一个网红的困境
title_en: 42K Followers Yet Still Seeking PMF: An Influencer's Dilemma
title_jp: 4.2万フォロワーなのにまだPMF探し：インフルエンサーのジレンマ
title_ar: 42 ألف متابع وما زال يبحث عن ملاءمة السوق: معضلة مؤثر

{"ops": [{"insert": "4.2万粉丝，却依然在找产品市场契合度：一个网红的困境"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://i.imgur.com/jo4YHpQ.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有见过这样的人——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Twitter上有4.2万粉丝，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "却还在寻找"那个产品"？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是他的故事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是 success story。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是 struggle story。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可能和你的故事更像。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【2020年的早上，在车库里】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年，疫情中，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和妻子搬回亚利桑那，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "住在她父母家。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早上打篮球，上班前。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在车库里，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听Indie Hackers播客。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "想着："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""就是今年了。今年我要开始 indie hacking。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不知道怎么搞，但我要 try something。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他一直想做自己的事，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "自从前一年发现播客，这种欲望 escalate。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "都是像他一样的人——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且他们找到了 success。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他上瘾了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一个半月后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " launch 了他的第一个产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【两周挑战：Vim for VSCode】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他和朋友决定做一个 Daniel Vassallo 在Twitter上推荐的挑战——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两周内 launch 一个 info product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他得想他知道 enough teach 或 write about 的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学Vim keybindings花了他很长时间，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他选了这个，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " maybe save someone else a couple weeks"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " by teaching them more efficiently。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他没真的 validate it，说实话。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但设了 expectation——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""好吧，如果卖超过100美元，就是 win。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "幸运的是，赢了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个周末赚了超过1000美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那是他的第一个产品，Vim for VSCode。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "基于练习的 course，教VSCode里Vim keybindings的基础。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一次性购买，每月产生100-300美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "总共收入1.5-2万美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【六个项目的真相】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还有五个其他项目在做："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "tscourse.com", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "——免费视频教程、文章、学TypeScript的播客。2000美元 workshop 收入。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "coworkwithfriends.com", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "——在本地社区通过咖啡店 coworking 交朋友。0收入（除了一些赞助的免费咖啡）。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "vocabminer.com", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "——Easy to find 西班牙语 text 和 articles 里的新词汇。0收入。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "speakargentinianspanish.com", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "——Newsletter 和 blog 帮你像 native 一样说阿根廷西班牙语。0收入。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "howmuchtomake.org", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "——免费计算器，算怎么达到卖一次性产品的 revenue 和 traffic 目标。0收入。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但基本上是"Instagram view"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你看到六个项目，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " assume 他有 sustain 所有这些的 secret trick"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " while working full-time job。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 reality 是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些 none 需要 maintenance。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Most 是"let's build this，launch，and let it sit"，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " basically that's it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他没法 compete with 单身没孩子的 indie hackers，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他 do what he can！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【时间管理的艺术】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他得非常 conscious with his time，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "变得非常擅长 break ideas into action plans and execute them。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Try break every step down as small as possible。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That way，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他能在 short periods of time knock out tasks——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "30分钟的午休，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "或周末孩子们午睡时的45分钟。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他写下甚至最基本的 steps，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为有了孩子，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "太容易 get distracted and forget what he's doing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Want to reduce any friction to making progress。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Plus，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " checking things off gives him a dopamine hit"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " which fuels him to keep going。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " whenever he can get started。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Having done the planning up front，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " easier see the finish line and not burn out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【找不到产品市场契合度的痛苦】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 main problem——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还没找到 stick 的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他卖过从10美元到5000美元 service 的所有东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "甚至一个月通过 service 和 products 组合赚过1万多美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然而，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " none of his things have had sustained growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "None of them have felt like "the one。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "感觉像 slow journey。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他甚至不知道怎么知道什么时候找到"the one"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他知道什么不 work——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "问朋友、家人、甚至 followers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们会告诉你是 good idea，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为 don't want hurt your feelings。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "读The Mom Test，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学怎么 ask the right questions。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " building "vitamins" 不 work。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你需要建 painkillers，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为你会找到更好的 product-market-fit，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建更 sustainable 的 business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "至于 what does work，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还在 figuring out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他认为 need a product make 1万/月 in first month"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and for at least three months in a row。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That might feel like "the one"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【TypeScript课程的 burnout】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他曾经以为找到了"the one"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是他的TypeScript课程。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He put it on a pedestal thinking，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""This is it。This is the big project I've been waiting for"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " that's going to pay off my mortgage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " I'm going to focus on it for the next 1.5 years"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and say no to everything else。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And that's what he did。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But his email list stagnated at 2k subscribers，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " despite launching more and more free content。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Working on the same thing with expectation for growth，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " then not seeing it grow……"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " it's really tough。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He got burnt out and put the project on hold。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Took a long break。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "To avoid this happening again，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " he's just been leaning into his energy more。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What problems does he have?"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What does he feel like building?"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What's something small he can build in a month，a week，a weekend?"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And then he builds that。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And since it's small，he doesn't get burnt out。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【网红的困境：依赖算法】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人们说你需要建 audience，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " figure out what they want，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " then sell to them。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他试过。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sometimes it works。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Honestly，in the beginning，it was his unfair advantage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当他 launch 第一个 course，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可能有2.5-3万 followers，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一个周末卖了100多份 course。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，他有4.2万 followers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这个策略让你 subject to constantly-changing algorithm，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and honestly，it feels like an impossible game to play"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " unless you know how to game it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nowadays，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " X algorithm 很像 TikTok。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Good in that anyone can go viral，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " but you have to have really good content or storytelling"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " to make it happen。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Or you have to be funny。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " Much harder for indie hackers to just build in public"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and catch some traction。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And he doesn't like playing that game"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " because he sucks at it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He just wants to build and solve problems。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【网红的局限：不能偏离受众】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Beyond that，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " to leverage your audience，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " you have to sell to your audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Early in his career，that was great。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He spent every second of every day thinking about programming。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And that was the audience he grew on Twitter——developers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But as he gets older，progresses in his career，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and has new priorities like his wife and kids——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " he just had his second child！——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " coding has shifted more from a "passion" to a "means to an end。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "It's a tool。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He still loves solving problems through code，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " but his heart pulls him in other directions as well。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "One example is language learning。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He loves it and wants to build products for it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But he doesn't have an audience there，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " so it's hard to sell a product to that community。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Twitter的真正价值：交朋友】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "All that said，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " there's one thing X is always good for——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " catching friends and opportunities。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "For example，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " he read a book about performance"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " after a coworker recommended it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Then wrote a blog post with his favorite quotes"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and shared it on LinkedIn。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "A month later，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " the CEO of a language learning company reached out via email"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and told him he loved the book"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and asked to hop on a call to talk about it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "It's things like this that only happen thanks to the internet。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Heck，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " three of the last jobs he's gotten"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " have been related to his online presence。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He's made so many friends online，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " gotten opportunities to speak at conferences，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and so much more。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The benefits are endless。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【Twitter增长策略】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他知道很多人想 grow their audiences。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And Twitter is still his biggest growth channel，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " so it's not a bad idea。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "The true power of a business，after all，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " isn't in the building of the product——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " it's in the marketing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just because you build it，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " doesn't mean they will come。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He wishes he could tell you he had this amazing Twitter strategy，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " but he didn't。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He honestly just engaged with people。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "For example："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ask questions", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Respond to other big accounts", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Offer free services like mentoring", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And it just grew organically。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Early days，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " he used to go by "JavaScript Joe""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " since he tweeted a lot about JS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That helped him grow a lot。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But like he said，it's harder now。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And to be honest，his follower count is mostly stagnant now。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【与YouTube网红合作】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Beyond using his Twitter following to grow Vim for VSCode，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " he also did a collaboration with a YouTuber"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " who happened to live in Arizona"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " and have a large tech audience。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That drew in around $3,500 in sales。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He was doing a series called "X in 100 seconds"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He explained Vim in 100 seconds，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " then let him use the second half of the video"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " walk through the basics。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He got the ad revenue generated by the video"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " for the lifetime of the video。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And he got to promote his product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【给初学者的建议】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 main takeaway——anyone can do it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He wishes he had known how easy it was to get started selling things online。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "He would have started years ago。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "You don't have to be an expert。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "You have to know what you're talking about，sure，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " but mostly，you just have to provide something that people want。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Just give yourself two weeks to validate or launch your idea，and do it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "And charge from the beginning。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "【你会继续寻找吗？】", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的故事不是 success story。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是 struggle story。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "4.2万粉丝，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " still looking for product-market fit。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这告诉我们——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Audience is not everything。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "You can have followers and still not have a business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "重要的是——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " keep trying。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " keep building。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " keep learning。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually，"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": " you'll find "the one"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Or maybe you won't。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但至少你在 try。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你在 learning。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你在 growing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这比什么都不做强多了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你呢？"}, {"insert": "

content_en: 42K Followers But Still Looking for Product-Market Fit: An Influencer's Dilemma. Have you seen someone like this: 42K followers on Twitter but still searching for that product? This is his story. Not success story. Struggle story. Might be more like yours. In 2020 morning in garage: 2020 during pandemic he and wife moved back to Arizona living with her parents. Before work played basketball. In garage listened to Indie Hackers podcast. Thinking: this is the year. This year I start indie hacking. Don't know how but try something. Always wanted to do his own thing since discovered podcast previous year desire escalated. Those are people like him finding success. Got hooked. A month and half later launched first product. Two-week challenge: Vim for VSCode. He and friend decided to do challenge Daniel Vassallo recommended on Twitter: launch info product in two weeks. Need know enough about something. Thought he knew enough about Vim.
content_jp: 4.2万フォロワーでもまだ製品市場適合を探しています：インフルエンサーのジレンマ这样的人你见过吗——Twitterに4.2万フォロワーいるけど、まだ“那个製品”を探している？这就是他的故事。成功故事じゃない。苦闘故事。、もしかしたら君のに似てるかも。2020年、车庫で：2020年、パンデミック中、彼は妻とアリゾナに戻って彼女の父母の間に合った。上班前にバスケットボールをした。车庫で、Indie Hackersポッドキャストを聞いた。想う：今年だ。今年からindie hacking始める不知道怎么搞，但我要try something。去年ポッドキャストを発見してから、いつも自分のことをしたかった欲望がエスカレート。彼らのように成功を見つける人们在听了播客后都上瘾了一个半月后，他推出了第一个产品。两周挑战：Vim for VSCode。他和朋友决定做Daniel Vassallo在Twitter上推荐的挑战——两周内发布一个信息产品。他需要对他知道足够多的事情有足够的了解。他认为他对Vim有足够的了解。
content_ar: 42K متابع لكن لا يزال يبحث عن ملاءمة المنتج والسوق: معضلة المؤثر. هل رأيت شخصًا مثل هذا: 42K متابع على Twitter لكنه لا يزال يبحث عن هذا المنتج؟ هذه قصته. ليست قصة نجاح. قصة كفاح. قد تكون أكثر شبهاً بك. في عام 2020 صباحًا في المرآب: خلال الجائحة انتقل هو وزوجته إلى أريزونا للعيش مع والديها. قبل العمل لعب كرة السلة. في المرآب استمع إلى بودكاست Indie Hackers. يفكر: هذه هي السنة. هذه السنة أبدأ indigo hacking. لا أعرف كيف لكن سأحاول شيئًا. أراد دائمًا فعل شيء خاص به منذ اكتشاف البودكاست العام الماضي الرغبة تصاعدت. هؤلاء أناس مثله يجدون النجاح. أصبح مدمنًا. بعد شهر ونصف أطلق أول منتج. التحدي أسبوعين: Vim for VSCode. هو وص решил сделать تحدي Daniel Vassallo على Twitter: إطلاق منتج معلوماتي في أسبوعين. يحتاج معرفة كافية عن شيء ما. 认为他对Vim有足够的了解。
